<div class="intro-text">
<p>I am Umashankar P., an interdisciplinary biochemist with research experience spanning lipid metabolism, mass spectrometry, molecular biology and genome engineering.</p>
<p>My current research focuses on sunflower lipid metabolism through CRISPR/Cas9 genome editing and metabolic engineering. I am particularly interested in connecting molecular interventions with quantitative metabolic phenotypes using GC-MS/MS and related analytical approaches.</p>
<p>I am interested in PhD opportunities, research collaborations and interdisciplinary projects at the interface of plant molecular biology, lipidomics, metabolic engineering and analytical science.</p>
</div>

## Research focus

<div class="focus-grid">
<div><i class="fa-solid fa-seedling"></i><h3>Plant Molecular Biology</h3><p>Sunflower transformation, tissue culture, regeneration, genotyping and gene-expression analysis.</p></div>
<div><i class="fa-solid fa-dna"></i><h3>Genome Engineering</h3><p>CRISPR/Cas9, gRNA strategy, cloning and genome-editing vector development.</p></div>
<div><i class="fa-solid fa-droplet"></i><h3>Lipid Metabolism</h3><p>TAG biosynthesis, fatty-acid composition, DGAT2, FAD genes and omega-3 enrichment.</p></div>
<div><i class="fa-solid fa-flask"></i><h3>Mass Spectrometry</h3><p>LC-MS/MS and GC-MS/MS method development, quantitative analysis and troubleshooting.</p></div>
</div>
